name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated Resource of 199 million ounces of silver and 1.7 million ounces of gold, with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study and all permits in hand. The company is advancing Diablillos toward first production targeted for 2029.
